_about: Indian brokers with an official MCP server, from each broker's own docs (checked 2026-11-22). connect.bundled = the server comes in the plugin's .mcp.json (shown in /mcp as plugin:ai-trader:<server>). Tool names marked known_tools come from those docs; everything else is matched from the real tool list when the user connects. tested = run with real orders by the plugin author.

brokers.name: Zerodha (Kite MCP)
brokers.auth: the login tool gives a link; one click per day

brokers.name: Dhan (DhanHQ MCP)
brokers.auth: OAuth: /mcp → dhan → Authenticate, sign in in the browser
brokers.protection_note: stop = a conditional trigger (alerts_agent_tool) with a linked SELL order, kept at Dhan across days; the MCP has no Forever Order (GTT/OCO) tool yet, so the target is watched by the bot
prerequisites: An active Dhan account with trading access
DDPI on the account (or the daily eDIS / TPIN step), or the bot's sell orders are rejected
Live quotes need Dhan's Data API plan (about ₹499/month); without it the bot uses the scan's prices
notes: Ready-made profile: the tools were read from the live MCP and the read-only ones checked on a real account (2026-11-22); the bot's own orders not run LIVE yet; conditional-trigger stops used with real orders by the author.
The MCP runs a funds check before each order.

brokers.name: FYERS (FYERS MCP)
brokers.auth: /mcp → fyers → Authenticate (FYERS sign-in). If Claude Code can't sign in, the docs' other route is an access token from the FYERS API dashboard sent as the Authorization header (needs a FYERS API app; the token lasts a day)
notes: create_gtt_order does single and OCO (two-leg) GTTs.

brokers.name: Groww (Groww MCP)
brokers.auth: a claude.ai connector: claude.ai → Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → https://mcp.groww.in/mcp → Connect. Groww's sign-in refuses Claude Code's own callback ("Invalid redirect URL", checked 2026-11-22), so the plugin doesn't bundle it
brokers.protection_to_check: whether its tools offer a GTT / stop-loss order
prerequisites: DDPI authorisation, or the bot's sell orders won't go through

brokers.name: Upstox (Upstox MCP)
brokers.auth: OAuth: /mcp → upstox → Authenticate; once a day
notes: The MCP is read-only: the bot reads holdings, cash and orders from it, and you place the orders it lists (Manual mode).

manual.name: Any other broker (Manual mode)
notes: No MCP needed. The bot works out every order and stop; you place them in your broker's app and tell it the fill.
